tools.name: lookup_property
tools.description: Resolve a free-text NYC address to its tax lot (BBL) and return the property facts: summary, owner of record, building, assessment, last priced deed and open-item counts. Returns the best match with a 0-1 confidence, a plain-English confidence_explanation, a machine-readable match_type, the HTML/Mar

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Return the full fact sheet for a tax lot by 10-digit BBL (borough-block-lot, e.g. 3030090016) or by 7-digit DOB building number (BIN). Requires "bbl" or "bin" (if both are sent, bbl is used).

tools.name: list_open_issues
tools.description: List every open item for a property: DOB jobs with a permit issued but no sign-off, active DOB and ECB violations, open HPD violations, and OATH tickets with an unpaid balance or a pending hearing. Each record has status, dates, a plain-English description and its source dataset. Requires one of "ad

tools.name: get_sales_history
tools.description: Deeds recorded with the NYC City Register (ACRIS) for a property: date, stated price (0 = non-market transfer), grantors, grantees, and whether the deed covers several lots. Requires one of "address", "bbl" or "bin".

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: List tax lots on a street (prefix match, e.g. "Grattan St") and/or in a ZIP code, with address, building class, units, owner of record and open-item count. Requires "street" and/or "zip"; borough and house_number only narrow the search. Paginate with limit/offset; total is the number of matches.
